papers.title_en: Advanced Image Generation: Negative Prompt Optimization and Latent Classifier Guidance
papers.authors: Vaddi Charan Sai Nandan Reddy, Harini B, Chandana M S
papers.evidence: 通过负提示优化实现图像生成中的概念抑制
papers.tldr: 文本到图像生成模型常依赖人工设计负面提示以避免伪影，但手工优化耗时且缺乏生成过程质量反馈。本文提出融合负面提示自动优化和潜在分类器引导的双向控制系统：通过微调T5 LLM自动生成语义精准的负面提示，同时部署CNN-LSTM混合分类器在扩散每一步评估潜在表示质量，对低分表示执行回滚至前一步。在COCO和PartiPrompts数据集上，该方法将伪影率降低37%，CLIP得分提升0.15，FID下降12%，用户偏好率达80%以上。该工作首次将负面提示优化与生成质量闭环控制结合，实现了低成本、高精度的自动化图像生成，显著提升生成可靠性与实用性。
papers.abstract_en: We present a novel system that integrates negative prompt optimization via a fine-tuned sequence-to-sequence LLM and latent-space classifier guidance to improve the quality of images generated by Stable Diffusion. Our approach automatically generates optimized negative prompts, and employs a CNN-RNN hybrid classifier to evaluate and guide diffusion steps, rolling back low-quality latent updates. Experimental results demonstrate that our dual-guidance framework reduces artifacts and improves semantic fidelity compared to baseline diffusion.
